views.name: {{project_name}} 프로젝트 보드
views.configure: FILTER "Project" = "{{record.project}}"; GROUP BY "Status"; SORT BY "Due Date" ASC; SHOW "Task", "Priority", "Type", "Area", "Assignee", "Sprint", "Due Date"

views.name: 업무 보드
views.configure: FILTER "Project" = "{{record.project}}"; GROUP BY "Status"; SORT BY "Due Date" ASC; SHOW "Task", "Priority", "Type", "Area", "Assignee", "Sprint", "Due Date"

views.name: Critical · High
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND (("Priority" = "Critical" OR "Priority" = "High") AND "Status" != "Done")); SORT BY "Due Date" ASC; SHOW "Task", "Status", "Priority", "Assignee", "Due Date", "Requirement"

views.name: 요구사항 현황
views.configure: FILTER "Project" = "{{record.project}}"; GROUP BY "Status"; SHOW "Requirement", "ID", "Priority", "Area", "Owner", "Task Count"

views.name: 최근 회의
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Type" != "Template"); SORT BY "Date" DESC; SHOW "Meeting", "Date", "Type", "Summary", "Action Count"

views.name: Sprint 일정
views.configure: FILTER "Project" = "{{record.project}}"; SORT BY "Start" ASC; TIMELINE BY "Start" TO "End"; SHOW "Sprint", "Status", "Goal", "Progress", "Task Count"

views.name: 내 업무
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Assignee" = "me" AND "Status" != "Done"); GROUP BY "Status"; SORT BY "Due Date" ASC; SHOW "Task", "Priority", "Area", "Sprint", "Due Date"

views.name: Sprint 목록
views.configure: FILTER "Project" = "{{record.project}}"; SORT BY "Start" ASC; TIMELINE BY "Start" TO "End"; SHOW "Sprint", "Status", "Goal", "Progress", "Task Count"

views.name: Sprint Tasks
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Sprint" IS NOT EMPTY); GROUP BY "Status"; SORT BY "Due Date" ASC; SHOW "Task", "Sprint", "Priority", "Assignee", "Due Date"

views.name: Task Timeline
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Status" != "Done"); TIMELINE BY "Start Date" TO "Due Date"; SHOW "Task", "Status", "Priority", "Area", "Assignee", "Sprint"

views.name: 회의 기록
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Type" != "Template"); SORT BY "Date" DESC; SHOW "Meeting", "Date", "Type", "Participants", "Summary", "Requirements", "Action Items", "Documents"

views.name: 회의록 템플릿
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Type" = "Template"); SHOW "Meeting", "Summary"

views.name: 요구사항 Lifecycle
views.configure: FILTER "Project" = "{{record.project}}"; GROUP BY "Status"; SHOW "Requirement", "ID", "Type", "Priority", "Area", "Owner", "Task Count"

views.name: 아이디어 Inbox
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Type" = "Idea"); SORT BY "Created" DESC; SHOW "Requirement", "ID", "Status", "Priority", "Area", "Owner"

views.name: AI 프롬프트 · 스킬
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND ("Category" = "AI Prompt" OR "Category" = "AI Skill")); SORT BY "Last Updated" DESC; SHOW "Document", "ID", "Category", "Status", "Owner", "Version", "Last Updated"

views.name: Frontend Tasks
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Area" = "Frontend"); GROUP BY "Status"; SORT BY "Due Date" ASC; SHOW "Task", "Priority", "Type", "Assignee", "Sprint", "Due Date"

views.name: Frontend Requirements
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Area" = "Frontend"); SORT BY "Priority" ASC; SHOW "Requirement", "ID", "Status", "Priority", "Owner", "Task Count"

views.name: Frontend Documents
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Area" = "Frontend"); SORT BY "Last Updated" DESC; SHOW "Document", "Category", "Status", "Version"

views.name: Backend Tasks
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Area" = "Backend"); GROUP BY "Status"; SORT BY "Due Date" ASC; SHOW "Task", "Priority", "Type", "Assignee", "Sprint", "Due Date"

views.name: Backend Requirements
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Area" = "Backend"); SORT BY "Priority" ASC; SHOW "Requirement", "ID", "Status", "Priority", "Owner", "Task Count"

views.name: Backend Documents
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Area" = "Backend"); SORT BY "Last Updated" DESC; SHOW "Document", "Category", "Status", "Version"

views.name: 전체 개발 문서
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND ("Category" = "Architecture" OR "Category" = "Frontend" OR "Category" = "Backend" OR "Category" = "Database" OR "Category" = "API" OR "Category" = "QA" OR "Category" = "Version Control" OR "Category" = "Deployment" OR "Category" = "Infrastructure")); SORT BY "Last Updated" DESC; SHOW "Document", "ID", "Category", "Area", "Status", "Owner", "Version", "Task Count", "Reference Count", "Last Updated"

views.name: QA · 버전 관리 · 배포
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND ("Category" = "QA" OR "Category" = "Version Control" OR "Category" = "Deployment")); SHOW "Document", "Category", "Status", "Version", "Owner"

views.name: Figma Workspace
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Type" = "Figma"); FILTER "Role" = "Workspace"; SHOW "Resource", "URL", "Status", "Area"

views.name: Design Tasks
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Area" = "Design"); GROUP BY "Status"; SHOW "Task", "Priority", "Assignee", "Sprint", "Due Date"

views.name: 프로젝트 바로가기
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Role" = "Workspace"); SHOW "Resource", "Type", "URL", "Status", "Area"

views.name: 개발 참고 · 학습 자료
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND ("Role" = "Reference" OR "Role" = "Learning") AND ("Area" = "Frontend" OR "Area" = "Backend" OR "Area" = "Database" OR "Area" = "AI" OR "Area" = "DevOps" OR "Area" = "General")); SORT BY "Last Updated" DESC; SHOW "Resource", "Role", "Type", "Area", "Topic", "Status", "URL", "Summary"

views.name: 경영 참고 자료
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Area" = "Business"); FILTER "Role" IN ("Reference", "Learning"); SORT BY "Last Updated" DESC; SHOW "Resource", "Role", "Type", "Topic", "Status", "URL", "Summary"

views.name: 학습 보드
views.configure: FILTER ("Project" = "{{record.project}}" AND "Role" = "Learning"); GROUP BY "Status"; SHOW "Resource", "Type", "Area", "Topic", "URL"
